purpose: Durable layout-only user workspace; runtime Widget props and domain data are forbidden

document.revisionEncoding: canonical decimal u64 JSON string; JSON numbers are rejected

commands.revisionEncoding: every request carries expected_revision as a canonical decimal u64 JSON string
commands.index: optional integer from 0 through 32; explicit null is rejected; omitted appends
commands.openWidget: Engine reuses instance_id as the placement node id and inserts only into tabs or stack; widget_type must be in layout.widgetTypes
commands.moveWidget: index addresses target children after source removal; omitted index appends
commands.resetLayout: commits the deterministic default layout as a higher immutable revision

persistence.revision: optimistic CAS; every successful mutation creates a higher immutable revision
persistence.retention: v1 keeps all committed immutable revisions; history responses are capped at 256 entries
persistence.rollback: forward commit of any validated committed ancestor; response history caps do not limit ancestry traversal; the current pointer never moves backward
persistence.unknownMajor: lossless raw UTF-8 JSON export plus SHA-256 only; mutation, reset and automatic migration are forbidden
